system_drawing_command: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $names=@('a_b_a_accumulation','replacement_replay','same_text_style_redraw','unknown_gray_no_divider'); foreach($n in $names){ $p=Join-Path (Get-Location) ('native/overlay/issue217_evidence/'+$n+'.png'); $im=[System.Drawing.Bitmap]::FromFile($p); $top=0; $bottom=0; $amin=255; $amax=0; for($y=0;$y -lt $im.Height;$y++){for($x=0;$x -lt $im.Width;$x++){ $c=$im.GetPixel($x,$y); $amin=[Math]::Min($amin,$c.A); $amax=[Math]::Max($amax,$c.A); if([Math]::Max($c.R,[Math]::Max($c.G,$c.B)) -gt 20){if($y -lt 168){$top++}else{$bottom++}} }}; [pscustomobject]@{name=$n;sha256=(Get-FileHash $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;top=$top;bottom=$bottom;alpha_min=$amin;alpha_max=$amax;pixel_format=$im.PixelFormat.ToString();mtime_utc=(Get-Item $p).LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $im.Dispose() }
